name: FontNames
description: Represents a list of the names of all the available fonts.
remarks: Use the FontNames, LandscapeFontNames, or PortraitFontNames property to return the FontNames object. The following example displays the number of portrait fonts available. This example lists all the font names in the FontNames object at the end of the active document. Use FontNames (Index), where Index is the index number, to return the name of a font. The following example displays the first font name in the FontNames object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of font names in the collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified FontNames object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a String that represents the name of a font.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.
